components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(250,250,249,0.1); border-radius: 24px; background: rgba(10,10,10,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px -20px rgba(10,10,10,0.5); } .ds-dock-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 72px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(250,250,249,0.06); border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(250,250,249,0.04); color: #FAFAF9; } .ds-mark { font-family: 'CabinetGrotesk-Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-mark span { color: #FF420B; } .ds-mark i { display: inline-block; width: 2px; height: .9em; margin-left: 3px; background: currentColor; animation: ds-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } } .ds-apps { gap: 4px; padding: 0 6px; } .ds-apps a { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #B0B0B0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-apps a:hover, .ds-apps a[aria-current=true] { background: rgba(250,250,249,0.08); color: #FAFAF9; } .ds-apps b { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; color: #FF420B; }

narrative.overview:
The whole system grows from the isotipo `n/h_`: an ember slash and a blinking caret. Every surface is a terminal session run by a craftsman. The room is obsidian, metadata is set in Geist Mono like command output, and one ember accent marks the line that matters right now. The precision is human. Cabinet Grotesk carries the voice in big, confident and slightly heavy cuts, while the mono layer stays quiet and exact. A 4% film grain sits over everything so the screen never looks sterile.

The same world runs at three intensities. The landing page is a performance: a full-bleed portrait in an obsidian room, a low ember light rising from the floor, giant uppercase headlines that rise line by line, and sections that switch between obsidian, warm stone and sand. The portal and admin are the same terminal at working volume. They are dark only, built from stepped near-black layers, with mono eyebrows, ember used for focus and for the current state, and nothing ornamental that slows a task. A floating dock (brand mark, section apps, language switch, live widgets) and the Samantha voice window are the system's signature: a small personal OS wrapped around the content.

Components are precise and tactile: pills that press, nested shells, hairline edges. They are confident but never loud. Motion follows one long ease-out curve, intentional and never bouncy.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian base with one ember accent per view. Brass is a rare, warm whisper.
Cabinet Grotesk for voice, Geist Mono for metadata, labels, buttons and numbers.
The `n/h_` caret and slash recur as motif: blinking cursor, ember slash bullets, typed brand messages.
Depth comes from tonal layers and hairlines. Shadows only for things that float.
A 4% grain overlay on every branded surface.
Fully bilingual: both languages render and `html[data-lang]` shows one.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Each view has one ember destination (one primary CTA or one current state). Everything else is neutral. Ember is about 10% of the palette budget at most, and its scarcity is what makes it read as "click here" or "you are here".

rules.name: The Brass Whisper Rule
rules.body: Brass appears only in text, numbers, initials or 1px outlines. It is never a fill, never a button, never more than 5% of a screen.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on dark is never `#FFFFFF`. Use Warm Stone or `heading-ink`. The only pure white is the label inside an ember fill.

rules.name: The Mono Annotates Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is reserved for what a terminal would print: labels, numbers, meta, buttons, timestamps and the tagline `artisan developer`. Headlines and prose are always Cabinet Grotesk.

rules.name: The Lowercase Name Rule
rules.body: `noehassiel` and `artisan developer` are always lowercase, even inside uppercase display settings.

rules.name: The Tonal Ladder Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift with shadows. A card that needs emphasis moves one step up the ladder (`inset` → `tertiary`) and takes an ember-tinted border (35–45% ember mix) on hover. Cast shadows are reserved for the dock, modals and the Samantha window.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: Every branded body (landing, portal, admin) carries the fixed fractal-noise overlay at 4% opacity. It sits above the background and below the content, and never captures pointer events.

rules.name: The Concentric Corners Rule
rules.body: A nested container's radius equals its parent's radius minus the padding between them (22 → 16 at 6px, 24 → 18 at 6px). Never put the same radius on a parent and its child.

dos: Do keep one ember destination per view (The One Ember Rule) and use `ember-deep` only for hover and pressed states.
Do set every button, label, number and piece of metadata in Geist Mono, and every headline and paragraph in Cabinet Grotesk.
Do move emphasis up the tonal ladder (`obsidian` → `card-black`/`surface` → `inset` → `tertiary`) with 1px hairlines instead of adding shadows.
Do animate with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`: 200ms for state, 0.4–0.6s for surfaces, 1.1s for hero entrances. Wrap entrances in `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
Do use an ember 2px outline with a 2–3px offset for `:focus-visible` everywhere.
Do reserve the dock's height at the bottom of every landing layout.
Do render both languages and let `html[data-lang]` choose. Never hard-code a single-language string on a branded surface.
donts: Don't write the name or tagline in anything but lowercase (`noehassiel`, `artisan developer`).
Don't use brass as a fill, button or background.
Don't use pure `#FFFFFF` for text on dark surfaces. Use Warm Stone or `heading-ink`.
Don't add drop shadows to cards. Cast shadows belong only to the dock, modals and the Samantha window.
Don't ship the starter kit's Instrument Sans or neutral-800 primary on a branded surface. Scope pages under `body.landing`, `body.portal` or `body.admin` so the brand tokens apply.
Don't use bouncy, elastic or spring-overshoot motion.
Don't offer a light mode for the portal or admin. They are dark by commitment.
Don't let the Samantha amber and red palette leak outside the Samantha component.
